(01) About

A face from the Dutch coast with a quiet intensity — moving easily between raw editorial and clean commercial work.

Franciscus grew up between the dunes and the city, and it shows in his work: relaxed, natural and always present in front of the lens. He has worked with photographers, stylists and brands across the Netherlands and Europe.

Comfortable on set, quick to take direction and easy to collaborate with, he brings energy to editorials, campaigns, lookbooks and runway. Open for international bookings and travel.
